escape_asterisks off leaves asterisks in a table cell unescaped

```r title="R"
library("htmltomarkdown", character.only = TRUE)

result <- convert(html = "<table><tr><td>2*3 = 6</td></tr></table>", options = ConversionOptions$from_json(jsonlite::toJSON(list("escape_asterisks" = FALSE), auto_unbox = TRUE)))
print(result$content)
```
